text.name: Salisbury and the Sleuths
text.rules: Record "nerve agent". LIO spends 1 point. SAE chooses: Deny everything? If yes, (draw from LIO's Contingency deck, then if the result is 3 or more, record "officers named", then LIO spends 2 points; otherwise, SAE spends 1 point); if no, LIO spends 1 point.
text.history: A former Russian officer and his daughter were poisoned with a Novichok nerve agent in Salisbury, England on 4 March 2018; Britain expelled 23 Russian diplomats, and in September and October 2018 the investigative group Bellingcat identified the two suspects as Russian military intelligence officers.
